ob_lede.message: Score homes, keep private notes, and build a side-by-side shortlist right on Zillow and Redfin — no account, no spreadsheet, no tracking.

ob_c1_text.message: Give each listing a 1–5 star score and a private note. It saves instantly and is still there when you come back.

ob_c2_text.message: Tap ♥ to add a home. Price, beds, baths and sqft are pulled in automatically — no typing.

ob_c3_text.message: See your favorites in one grid, sort by price or score, and (with Pro) export the whole list to CSV.

ob_s2.message: Rate it and jot a note

ob_s3d.message: Add your favorites, then open the popup to compare them side by side.
